bioconda.name: bonefish
bioconda.summary: Fast aligner for Oxford Nanopore DNA, direct RNA and cDNA reads, with minimap2-level accuracy.
bioconda.description:
bonefish aligns Oxford Nanopore reads (FASTQ, FASTA or dorado BAM) to a reference and
writes SAM, PAF or a coordinate-sorted, indexed BAM. Genomic DNA uses minimap2's lr:hq
seeding and scoring with cheaper chaining and alignment, validated against GIAB truth sets;
direct RNA and cDNA (-x rna, -x cdna) use minimap2's spliced presets with faster intron
alignment, validated against minimap2, GENCODE and simulated reads.
